admin.title: Admin panel
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete this item permanently? This cannot be undone.

consent.label: Consent scope
consent.help: Publishing on the site and feeding the chatbot are separate permissions. An item marked “No AI use” is published but never enters the chatbot index.

fields.slugHelp: Lowercase, numbers and hyphens. It appears in the public address and should not change once published.
fields.title: Title
fields.personNameHelp: Shown publicly only when attribution is “Named”. Never exposed on anonymous or pseudonymous items.
fields.sensitivityHelp: High-sensitivity material is hosted on our own storage and never embedded from an external service.
fields.altTextHelp: Required to publish visual content. Describe the image for those who cannot see it.

subtitles.title: Subtitle tracks
subtitles.help: Spanish serves accessibility; English serves translation. Both are required to publish audiovisual material.

coverage.title: Coverage by community
coverage.help: How much exists, how much is published and how much feeds the chatbot are three different numbers. The gap between them is consent.

archiveHealth.title: Archive ingestion
archiveHealth.help: Documents detected in the archive folder and their situation relative to the catalogue.

pending.title: Awaiting data
pending.help: These sections activate once the capability they depend on exists. They are deliberately empty: reporting zero would suggest there is no usage, when what is missing is the feature.
